config.fit: Reuse all 32 H593 discovery basis directions without refitting; test full available context span, incoming-response span, and both. No outcomes used to alter basis.
config.identity: Context-switch response T(dc,e)=Down(Left(dc)*Right(e)+Left(e)*Right(dc)). Quadratic-in-e term cancels exactly.
config.design: Project context only, incoming response only, or both onto the entire stored 32-direction discovery spans. Full-context-switch and unchanged-context references. Both signs/doses and all H593 cells retained.
config.scope: Actual context/input coefficients remain required. Irregular nouns and relative-clause rows are held out from basis fitting but previously explored. No novel corpus or learned coefficient generator. Rank1-both is one scalar-times-scalar output vector, not yet a semantic unit.
